messages:
anna (sec-eng): FYI — restore job for tenant-42 in staging failed during the post-restore validation. Getting KMS AccessDenied on Decrypt twice at ~10:05 UTC. Suspect the RBAC cleanup from yesterday broke the grant flow.

anna (sec-eng): ```
Error: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/restore-agent-role/restore-runner is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345
Trace: restore-2165009999
```

mike (encops): Which principal did the call as? restore-agent-role? Any CloudTrail CreateGrant logs around that time?

anna (sec-eng): Principal is the service account mapped to restore-agent-role. I checked CloudTrail: no kms:CreateGrant entry for that trace id — looks like CreateGrant never happened.

sam (sre): We saw something similar last month when ephemeral grants were ttl-pruned too aggressively. Do we still use CreateGrant+Decrypt (ephemeral grants) for cross-account snapshot decrypts?

eli (infra): Yes — flow is: restore runner calls KMS:CreateGrant (with retiring principal), then Decrypt with the grant token. If CreateGrant fails due to missing iam:PassRole or missing kms permissions on the service account, Decrypt fails. I just checked the RBAC diff from yesterday — iam:PassRole was removed for a set of uploader/restore service accounts.

anna (sec-eng): That would explain missing CreateGrant. Curious: CloudTrail also doesn't show a failed CreateGrant attempt — either the call never reached KMS or it was blocked earlier (IAM deny).

mike (encops): If the IAM change prevented the call from being made we should see an APIDenied log. Are we filtering CloudTrail correctly? Also we need a short mitigation rather than giving tenants long-lived kms:Decrypt.

deploy-bot: incident created: restore-2165009999. Assigned: @sam @eli @mike

sam (sre): I'll re-run the restore with debug flags and capture the full network/log trace. ETA ~30m.

eli (infra): I'll open an emergency RBAC exception to restore iam:PassRole for the restore service account so it can CreateGrant. I'll also add a guardrail PR so future RBAC prunes warn on roles tagged "grant-creator".

mike (encops): Prefer not to add long-lived kms:Decrypt permissions. Temp fix = re-enable CreateGrant path. Longer term: add unit test and alerting for grant-creation failures and a CloudTrail monitor for kms:CreateGrant and kms:RetireGrant anomalies.

anna (sec-eng): Agreed. Also we need to fix observability: CloudTrail filter didn't surface the failed CreateGrant. eli — can you add a saved query for kms:CreateGrant invocations that returns 404/AccessDenied or no responses?

eli (infra): Yep — adding saved query + automated Slack alert if CreateGrant errors > 0 in 15m. Also adding a janitor whitelist so we don't prune grants for keys tagged with "in-use-by:restore" within 1h of creation.

sam (sre): Debug run results: CreateGrant returned 403 due to iam:PassRole missing. After eli's RBAC exception (temporary) the same restore re-run succeeded. Logs: ```CreateGrant -> 403 IAMDenied; retry -> CreateGrant 200; Decrypt 200 -> restore ok```

anna (sec-eng): Great. Steps to close: eli — submit RBAC PR to re-add iam:PassRole and include the guardrail. sam — attach debug logs to the incident. mike — open runbook PR to add test and alert. I'll ping CS about tenant-42 (staging) and note it did not hit prod.

mike (encops): Also add a short-term mitigation doc: if CreateGrant is failing, manual path = create a temporary grant with kms:CreateGrant from Security rotation role and include the restore-runner principal, then retire after restore. Document the commands.

eli (infra): RBAC PR created and link posted: https://git.internal/rbac/pr/9987 — includes guardrail and janitor tweak.

sam (sre): Logs uploaded to the incident: s3://internal-logs/restore-2165009999/debug.log — shows exact failure and successful retry after RBAC exception.

anna (sec-eng): Closing loop: RBAC PR merged, janitor rule updated, CloudTrail saved query + alert deployed, and runbook PR opened by mike. Marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:

mike (encops): Postmortem note: add one-liner to release checklist to verify grant-creator role mappings aren't removed by bulk RBAC cleans.

anna (sec-eng): Thanks everyone — good catch.
